header: Deleting domains that use Amazon Cognito authentication for OpenSearch Dashboards
content:
OpenSearch Dashboards
To prevent domains that use Amazon Cognito authentication for Dashboards from becoming stuck
in a conﬁguration state of Processing, delete OpenSearch Service domains before deleting their
associated Amazon Cognito user and identity pools.
